items.title: Drake Maye: Could be dealing with significant lower-leg inury
items.text:
Maye is believed to have sustained a significant lower-leg injury that could sideline him for an extended period of time, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network and ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DK Metcalf: Gets into end zone in loss
items.text:
Metcalf brought in two of six targets for 54 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion catch in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylen Warren: Stymied by Bengals in loss
items.text:
Warren rushed seven times for 15 yards and brought in five of six targets for 26 yards in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night. He committed a fumble recovered by Pittsburgh.

items.title: Tee Higgins: Five catches in Week 10 win
items.text:
Higgins brought in five of six targets for 66 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night.

items.title: Chase Brown: Garners 18 touches in win
items.text:
Brown rushed 10 times for 44 yards and brought in eight of nine targets for 39 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night.
